participant_1.background: i like to eat chocolate candy. i'm four years old. i like to talk but people have a hard time understanding. i like to look at blocks and sing about letters.

participant_2.name: Henry
participant_2.personality: Wise and reflective, enjoys sharing stories from the past.
participant_2.background: i remember when nobody had a television. i love to drink wine and dance in the moonlight. i am very strong for my age. i'm 100 years old. i feel like i might live forever.
